facts.text: I am looking for gift ideas for my mom's anniversary.
I narrowed my gift options to a personalized photo album, customized jewelry, or a gourmet food basket.
My budget for the gift is $150-$200.
I decided to go with the customized jewelry option.
I found a similar necklace online that I got for my sister's birthday for $75.
I am hoping to find something around $75 or a bit higher.
I made an impulse buy last week at my favorite bookstore.
I bought a book for $24 after a discount at my favorite bookstore.
I plan to check online marketplaces, especially Etsy.
I have had good experiences with Etsy before.
I want to find a local jewelry store that can help me customize a piece.
I want the customized jewelry to include a birthstone or a special message.
I want to find a jewelry store that can customize a piece with a special message or birthstone.
I want the jewelry store to offer a gift receipt so my mom can exchange it.
I will ask about the gift receipt and exchange policy when I visit local jewelry stores.
I want peace of mind knowing my mom can exchange the gift if she doesn't like it.
I want to ask the jeweler to include a personalized note or message with the gift.
I want the personalized note or message to be like a birthday card or a small note with a special message.
I plan to ask the jeweler for recommendations for a special message or ideas.
I want to know whether it is a good idea to keep the message short and sweet or make it longer and more heartfelt.
